location: third candidate festival site south of Eurazania capital

maestro.decision: selected third site as primary festival location; second site retained as backup

festival_site.primary: third site: broad valley with multiple natural terraces, nearby river, enough space to separate tournament, stage, market and traveler camp
advantages: traveler camp can be separated from main festival
tournament and stage can occupy separate areas
farther from capital reduces pressure on city traffic
festival_site.known_drawback: approach road is narrower/worse than second site; cart traffic must be managed or road improved

next_steps: coordinate with Borga and land officials
